title: Measuring What Matters: Connecting AI Ethics Evaluations to System Attributes, Hazards, and Harms
reasoning: This paper is a scoping review focused on evaluating and analyzing 791 distinct measures used to assess AI adherence to ethical principles such as fairness, transparency, privacy, and trust. The research specifically aims to connect these technical evaluations to sociotechnical harms, making the assessment of ethics its primary research objective.
